title: What #1298 left owed: status text reads its readable shade in every tokenized sheet, a re-cut moves only what it was cut for, JA templates with a light/dark switch keep it from their next release, the agent ladder's faults
expect: S1: every test passes: a status colour set as text takes --ds-c-<status>-text (fills and lines keep the status), through a variable only text reads too, a sheet tokenized before moves its status text and a second run moves nothing; reRole moves only the named slots by property; filePalettes gives one sheet its own palette; moveOnly tokenizes nothing new; a body-class dark hook scopes the two sides with no OS auto side.
S2: every test passes: a template line's contracts each hold their own releases (JA Podcast 1.0.4 one look, 1.0.5 both sides), the line's range is every contract's together.

S3: every test passes: a picture an element's own style paints is the picture beside its words, marked background; a removal receipt asks for one look at the page and the gap closed or said; the Design system row is named as the screen labels it.
evidence: Before this change form feedback, .text-* and outline buttons in 70 released templates read 2-3:1 under most systems, JA Podcast, Blockk, Boxing and Titan hid their light/dark switch under every system, and the agent sent a card out with its title alone and left a blank half row after a removal
fence: Unworn, every page is the release's own (VERIFICATION.json of each re-cut); a site on a release before the two-mode contract keeps one look; a sheet's other slots never move in a re-cut
